description: GZCLP T1 squat — complete stage machine walk: Stage1 success, Stage1 failure → Stage2, Stage2 failure → Stage3, Stage3 success → reset to Stage1

steps.note: Fresh start — T1 Stage 1: 5 sets × 3 reps, AMRAP on last set. Lower body starts at 45 lbs.
Success at Stage 1: +10 lbs (lower body increment), still Stage 1
Failure at Stage 1 → advance to Stage 2: now 6×2 with AMRAP, hold weight at 55 lbs
Failure at Stage 2 → advance to Stage 3: now 10×1 (no AMRAP — singles don't AMRAP), hold weight at 55 lbs
Success at Stage 3 → reset to Stage 1: +10 lbs (success still earns increment), back to 5×3 AMRAP
